isc_identity_profiles._note: Simplified model of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) identity profiles, identity attribute mappings and transforms. Transform names and attributes follow the transform JSON documented on developer.sailpoint.com; only a subset is simulated and any other type is refused (deny by default).

required_attributes.uid: required by ISC on every identity profile
required_attributes.email: required by ISC; not validated as an email address
required_attributes.firstname: required by company policy, not by ISC itself
required_attributes.cloudLifecycleState: required by company policy so lifecycle state actions run

sign_in_methods.USERNAME_PASSWORD: users sign in with the user name and password they set when they registered
sign_in_methods.DIRECTORY_CONNECTION: users sign in with the password of the source chosen as the authentication source (pass-through authentication)
sign_in_methods.MFA: users sign in with a mobile authenticator app

outcome_definitions.OK: Every mapping produced a value, every required attribute is set and the uid is unique: the identity is created.
outcome_definitions.MAPPING_ERROR: A required attribute has no mapping or is empty, or the lifecycle state is not one the profile defines.
outcome_definitions.TRANSFORM_ERROR: A transform failed or is unknown, so no value was stored for that attribute.
outcome_definitions.DUPLICATE_UID: The uid is already used by another identity from any identity profile.
outcome_definitions.NO_PROFILE: None of the person's accounts is on a source that an identity profile uses as authoritative.

concepts.identity profile: The configuration that turns the accounts of one authoritative source into identities and sets their attribute mappings and sign-in settings.
concepts.authoritative source: A trusted source, usually HR, whose accounts create identities instead of only being linked to them.
concepts.transform: A JSON rule that changes a source value on its way into an identity attribute, such as lower-casing it or looking it up in a table.
concepts.implicit input: The source attribute chosen in the mapping, which a transform uses when it has no explicit input of its own.
concepts.pass-through authentication: Signing in to the identity platform with the password of another source, such as the corporate directory.
concepts.cloudLifecycleState: The identity attribute whose calculated value selects one of the profile's lifecycle states, such as active or inactive.
concepts.profile priority: The number that decides which profile wins for a person on two authoritative sources; the lower number wins.
